sources.title: From Type II string theory toward BSM/dark sector physics

evidence.text: Which gauge representations, axions and massive gauge bosons can supply BSM/dark sectors in controlled string compactifications, and how reliably can their four-dimensional effective interactions be derived? This is a review of explicitly accessible constructions.

sources.title: String Gases and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can a population of extended closed strings be represented as matter in a lower-dimensional effective theory while retaining its momentum, winding, and oscillator dependence?

sources.title: Note on shape moduli stabilization, string gas cosmology and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: How does shearing an equal-radius internal torus away from a square affect the masses of the retained momentum–winding strings?

sources.title: Emergence of CY triple intersection numbers in M-theory

evidence.text: Can classical triple intersection numbers controlling weakly coupled type IIA vector-multiplet kinetic terms emerge from a regularized one-loop sum over light D2-D0 bound states in the isotropic M-theory limit?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local String Models

evidence.text: How do bulk-volume-dependent gauge thresholds change the apparent unification scale of local brane models, and can they alleviate the tension between intermediate string scales motivated by supersymmetry breaking and the historically inferred supersymmetric unification scale near 10^16 GeV?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local Orientifolds

evidence.text: When do gauge thresholds in local orientifold models behave as running from the string scale or the bulk winding scale, and how can the string calculation agree with the Kaplunovsky–Louis supergravity expression?

sources.title: A Solution to the Decompactification Problem in Chiral Heterotic Strings

evidence.text: Can chiral heterotic strings with two large dimensions and Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking avoid gauge thresholds growing linearly with internal volume, so that a Kaluza–Klein scale far below the string scale need not destroy perturbative gauge couplings?

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Can a nonsupersymmetric, tachyon-free heterotic model supply an effective framework for visible matter, dark sectors and cosmology? The paper studies this question using a reviewed ten-dimensional SO(16) × SO(16)' construction and mostly low-energy descriptions.

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: How does gauge-derived breaking arise in the reviewed string constructions? Brane U(1) vectors become Stückelberg massive, and wrapped Euclidean branes violate the remaining perturbative global charges.

sources.title: Moduli-dependent Calabi-Yau and SU(3)-structure metrics from Machine Learning

evidence.text: Can learned internal metrics enable normalized particle spectra, their moduli dependence, bundle connections, special-cycle calculations, and fibration diagnostics? These questions motivate potential applications to string phenomenology, the distance conjecture, and stabilization.

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local String Models

evidence.text: The string analysis extracts the O(B²) vacuum-energy term in a background magnetic field. It evaluates annulus amplitudes using Chan–Paton traces, spin-structure sums and theta identities; modular transformations and a toroidal lattice sum expose the closed-string tadpole interpretation and bulk cutoff.

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local Orientifolds

evidence.text: Determine relative signed twisted-modulus couplings by factoring the vacuum tadpole out of the B² annulus UV amplitude. B⁴ exchange alone determines squared couplings and loses these signs. Compare the result with supergravity after linear-to-chiral multiplet dualization.

sources.title: From Type II string theory toward BSM/dark sector physics

evidence.text: Topological cycle intersections determine net chirality. Explicit CFT states with Chan–Paton labels determine chirality and localization; beta-function contributions extracted from one-loop amplitudes count massless representations without assigning chirality.

sources.title: A Solution to the Decompactification Problem in Chiral Heterotic Strings

evidence.text: BPS saturation, modularity and quasi-holomorphy constrain the exact-N=2 integrand. The current trace contains Q_a²-k_a/(4πτ2); matching gravitational thresholds fixes the universal coefficient A=-1/48 in this orbifold class.

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Reduce on four equal-radius two-spheres, shift the dilaton to absorb the internal volume and then retain homogeneous zero modes. The procedure produces a two-dimensional gravity–scalar action whose lapse constraint can be canonically quantized.

sources.title: String Gases and the Swampland

evidence.text: Retain the enhanced-symmetry light sector near the self-dual torus and suppress heavier states thermally. The paper then uses N = 1, n = −w states throughout its modulus analysis; the extension to large excursions is not controlled by the local truncation argument.

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: String background fields and Riemann-Cartan geometry

evidence.text: Can relaxing the compact-direction stress-energy symmetry of a wrapped classical spinning membrane produce effective-string couplings matching all four background fields Gμν, Bμν, Aμ and Φ of the string sigma model?

sources.title: From supermembrane to matrix string

evidence.text: How can a circle-wrapped supermembrane be related directly to matrix string from an eleven-dimensional viewpoint, without DLCQ or string dualities, and can this correspondence construct nonlinear background couplings?

sources.title: Low energy models of string theory

evidence.text: Which compactification geometries and fluxes produce plausible four-dimensional string effective theories, and how do swampland constraints and nonrelativistic strings extend this discussion?

sources.title: Matrix models, topological strings, and supersymmetric gauge theories

evidence.text: Can ordinary matrix models supply large-N duals of topological B-strings without double scaling, reproduce Calabi-Yau special geometry, and compute F-terms of associated N=1 gauge theories? What geometries arise when double scaling is subsequently imposed?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric bulk couplings encode the tensions and interactions of strings and membranes?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Bootstrapping String Theory

evidence.text: How can spacetime and worldsheet bootstrap methods determine string/M-theory amplitudes, constrain AdS vacua and string universality, and construct unfamiliar worldsheet theories? This white paper selectively reviews progress and proposes research targets.

sources.title: Stringy Bubbles Solve de Sitter Troubles

evidence.text: Can near-singular, nonfactorizing string backgrounds support an observable four-dimensional de Sitter subspacetime, and can axilaton cosmic-brane models acquire bubble-nucleation dynamics and a Calabi–Yau fivefold interpretation?

sources.title: The power of M theory

evidence.text: What relations among higher p-branes and their tensions follow by identifying M theory on R9×T2 with Type IIB on R9×S1, and M theory on R10×S1 with Type IIA in ten dimensions?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: G2 geometry determines the four-dimensional fields, Planck scale, classical metric, and calibrations used to discuss weak coupling and wrapped-brane strings.

sources.title: Non-geometric backgrounds in string theory

evidence.text: How are non-geometric string configurations constructed and described through T-duality, torus fibrations, generalised and doubled geometry, and what effects do their fluxes have on compactification and closed-string algebraic structures?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: How far can duality twists extend across string theories, fiber geometries, and twisted sectors while retaining controlled low-energy physics?

sources.title: U-duality in quantum M2-branes and gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Can quantum M2-branes with flux and SL(2,Z) monodromy supply a microscopic interpretation of nine-dimensional type IIB triplet gaugings, their restricted mass parameters, and their U-duality groups?

sources.title: D = 6, N=1 string vacua and duality

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, compactification geometry, T-duality and conjectured strong/weak dualities organize six-dimensional N=1 string vacua and their nonperturbative transitions? The lectures also examine the resulting four-dimensional N=2 theories.

sources.title: D-brane primer

evidence.text: How do worldsheet string theory and T-duality lead to dynamical D-branes, their worldvolume gauge theories, R–R charges, and applications to string duality and spacetime geometry? These are preparatory lecture notes, rather than a paper organized around a new research result.

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: What is the simplest conventional-matter brane with maximally symmetric stress-energy and spin that probes spacetime torsion, and what effective string coupling results when such a membrane wraps a small compact dimension?

sources.title: String Theory, the Dark Sector, and the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can a doubled, noncommutative formulation of string theory connect dark energy, dark matter and the Higgs hierarchy through UV/IR correlations, and motivate a nonperturbative formulation with emergent spacetime and supersymmetry?

evidence.text: Can worldsheet RG interpolations explicitly realize several ten-dimensional string theories meeting at a nine-dimensional junction, as motivated by the Cobordism Conjecture, and accommodate consistent flows of chiral fields between branches?

sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: When can a continuous family connecting black Dp-branes to static Kaluza-Klein bubbles represent a physical decay, and can winding closed-string tachyon condensation provide the mechanism and a stable static endpoint?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric D1/D5 and F/NS5 supergravity families interpolate between black configurations and KK bubbles, and under what stability and validity conditions can these interpolations model closed-string tachyon condensation?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Does the order-one tachyon bound survive when the unstable mode overlaps the volume of an orientifold-wrapped cycle rather than lying entirely in the universal volume–dilaton sector?

sources.title: Don't panic! Closed string tachyons in ALE space-times

evidence.text: What is the fate of closed-string tachyons localized at noncompact nonsupersymmetric orbifold fixed points, under both worldsheet RG flow and on-shell time evolution? Can their condensation reach flat space or supersymmetric ALE geometries while remaining weakly coupled?

sources.title: Closed string tachyons and semiclassical instabilities

evidence.text: Can perturbative closed-string tachyons and semiclassical gravitational instabilities describe the same decay, with bulk tachyon condensation at nonzero coupling ending in spacetime annihilation?

sources.title: On Witten's Instability and Winding Tachyons

evidence.text: Can winding tachyons lower the barrier for Witten's bubble-of-nothing decay, providing a spacetime explanation of Horowitz's conjecture that black strings catalyze Kaluza–Klein vacuum decay?

sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: The proposed tachyon transition is tested by matching charge, transverse horizon/bubble size and asymptotic circle length in controlled limits. Chargeless F-strings are inferred by matching a neutral specialization of the intersecting solutions to another F-string/Dp-brane family.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Start from a non-supersymmetric type IIA D0/D4 intersection, solve for a transverse delocalization creating an isometry, and T-dualize to D1/D5. Unlike BPS arrays, this delocalization cannot rely on a no-force construction.

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordisms in General Relativity and String Theory

evidence.text: Uses thick-thin decomposition and the Margulis lemma to organize short-cycle regions into garters and cusps. Local Kaluza-Klein reductions on their small circles or tori provide effective descriptions with different compact topologies and potentially different effective dimensions.

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Select an instantaneous Minkowski state when each mode reaches k/a=Λ, then evolve it below the cutoff. This continuous entry rule replaces the unlimited ultraviolet tracing used for Bunch–Davies selection.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Scan λ and four scalar variables in the stated bounded box, retain positive selected pieces with residuals below 0.05, and inspect the smallest logarithmic-Hessian eigenvalue. Tightening the residual is a convergence diagnostic rather than proof of exhaustive critical-point coverage.

sources.title: A Matrix Theory Construction of the IIA/IIB Wall

evidence.text: Engineer a localized D0 through electric-flux sectors sourced by conjugate Wilson lines, whose infrared limits are reflective conformal interfaces. Use time-dependent irrelevant CFT perturbations and adiabatic switching to argue transmission and finite wall stress-energy.

sources.title: T-duality for non-critical heterotic strings

evidence.text: Determine the global deformation spaces and T-duality groups of full-rank non-critical heterotic strings on a circle, and interpret their symmetry enhancements and dimension-changing tachyon condensation in terms of heterotic branes.
